verdict.rationale: Entra ID documents device registration and join, which ties device identity to user SSO. It also names device identities as the prerequisite for device-based Conditional Access and for MDM through the Microsoft Intune family, so device enrollment and identity-tied policy enforcement are covered. Remote lock/wipe and the depth of the Intune integration are not evidenced, and Entra itself is not shown performing MDM. Missing for 10: remote lock/wipe tied to identity, detailed MDM integration docs (enrollment flow, compliance policy enforcement), independent or hands-on corroboration.
